author: dev_revs
body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: Teamspeak

Staff Member: Not a staff member, but Zac.

Guilty? (Yes or No): Depends on how you see it.

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: I poked zac "next time you don't leave my channel when asked ur fking ded" and I was banned for thirty days. I have heard from multiple sources that I should of gotten a kick first. Zac has been abusing his powers and attacking me for reporting him multiple times. If you don't know the situation, he used my team channel along with ten others for a scrim when he was asked to leave he didn't and then muted my team member for playing music. I have had enough of his shit. I will gladly share his messages on skype towards me(I understand it doesn't mean much due to it not being an avicus platform). I have heard from Spanish players that he moves them out for talking to Americans in the Spanish chat and its only a couple words. This is my first offense on teamspeak and this most defiantly was not worth a thirty day ban. Zac is out to get me because I am standing up for the community against him.

Any additional comments?: He took away our teamspeak channel too. Don't know the deal behind that.

This is not the place to report me, this is a place for appealing your infraction which is completely valid. I will now lock this appeal, please do not create another unless it is an apology or presents new evidence or it will be considered spam.

Sincerely,
Zac.
